subject: Ed25519 Yao benchmark pair on Cloudflare, activation circuit, 128 KiB frames, same-account Service Binding WebSocket
source: seams-wallet 67ac0f5d plus the measurement-only yield-after-table-frame feature; SIMD runs add RUSTFLAGS -C target-feature=+simd128 to both roles
client: Node.js fetch from Tokyo, sequential POSTs
limitations: Tail sampling delivered 11 to 16 of 21 invocations in the Tokyo runs and all 31 in the Hong Kong runs.
The Worker clock excludes the invocation own CPU time; client wall and the tail wall time are the real durations.
The Hong Kong runs enter at the Tokyo edge and execute in the placement region; client wall includes that hop.
A benchmark pair has no admission, product checks, sealing or durable record.

firstCeremonyOfAnIsolate.method: Ten cycles. Each deploys a new version of both benchmark Workers (yield variant, SIMD build), sends Deriver A one request that runs no ceremony, waits two seconds, and runs five ceremonies. CPU values come from the tail of each Worker and can miss invocations.
